title: ₹17 lakh crore at risk? The NPS row explained
ticker: ₹17 lakh crore at risk? Why the largest NPS employees' union wants a CAG audit and the NPS Trust dissolved

scenes.title: ₹17 lakh crore at risk?
scenes.say: The retirement savings of nearly 1 crore government employees. A corpus of about 17 lakh crore rupees. And a union that says it could be at risk.
scenes.speak: The retirement savings of nearly one crore government employees. A corpus of about seventeen lakh crore rupees. And a union that says it could be at risk.

scenes.label: Pension savings of nearly 1 crore employees
scenes.say: That money sits in the National Pension System, the NPS. It belongs to Central and state government employees, saved month after month for the day they retire.
scenes.speak: That money sits in the National Pension System, the N P S. It belongs to Central and state government employees, saved month after month for the day they retire.

scenes.title: Members the union represents
scenes.say: The All India NPS Employees Federation, the largest union of NPS members, represents about 28 lakh Central government staff and nearly 70 lakh in the states.
scenes.speak: The All India N P S Employees Federation, the largest union of N P S members, represents about twenty-eight lakh Central government staff and nearly seventy lakh in the states.

scenes.title: A complaint to the PM
scenes.say: Now that union has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Its president, Manjeet Singh Patel, has filed a complaint with the Prime Minister's Office.

scenes.label: Proposed investment from the pension corpus
scenes.say: At the heart of it is a proposed investment of 17,000 crore rupees from the pension corpus.
scenes.speak: At the heart of it is a proposed investment of seventeen thousand crore rupees from the pension corpus.

scenes.title: Two firms, called startups
scenes.say: The money would go to two firms the union describes as startups, Altirra Capital and Trifecta. The union says it was committed without adequate guarantees.
scenes.speak: The money would go to two firms the union describes as startups, Altirra Capital and Trifecta. The union says it was committed without adequate guarantees.

scenes.label: Symbolic cheques reportedly handed over
scenes.say: The row grew louder after symbolic cheques worth 400 crore rupees were reportedly presented to the two firms on NPS Day.
scenes.speak: The row grew louder after symbolic cheques worth four hundred crore rupees were reportedly presented to the two firms on N P S Day.

scenes.text: How these institutions could commit public money to startups.
scenes.role: President, All India NPS Employees Federation
scenes.say: Patel asks why so much of employees' retirement savings is going into high-risk ventures without clear safeguards, and how the institutions involved could commit public money to startups.

scenes.title: Who the union is questioning
scenes.say: He names the NPS Trust, the pension regulator PFRDA, the ratings agency CRISIL, and private advisers in the investment framework.
scenes.speak: He names the N P S Trust, the pension regulator P F R D A, the ratings agency CRISIL, and private advisers in the investment framework.

scenes.title: What the union wants
scenes.say: The demands are sweeping. Dissolve the NPS Trust at once. A full audit by the Comptroller and Auditor General. Recover any losses, and fix accountability for the lapses it alleges.

scenes.title: What the inquiry should cover
scenes.say: It wants an inquiry into how the 17,000 crore commitment came about, what due diligence was done, what protects employees' money, and whether there was a conflict of interest.
scenes.speak: It wants an inquiry into how the seventeen thousand crore commitment came about, what due diligence was done, what protects employees' money, and whether there was a conflict of interest.

scenes.text: Returns on public retirement funds have remained unsatisfactory over the past five years and turned negative during the last year.
scenes.say: Patel also takes aim at performance. He says returns on public retirement funds have been unsatisfactory for 5 years, and turned negative last year.
scenes.speak: Patel also takes aim at performance. He says returns on public retirement funds have been unsatisfactory for five years, and turned negative last year.

scenes.label: Figure cited in the IL&FS crisis. The union fears 'several times' worse
scenes.say: And he reaches for a frightening comparison: the IL&FS collapse, where a figure of 92,000 crore rupees was cited. He warns the fallout here could be several times worse.
scenes.speak: And he reaches for a frightening comparison: the I L and F S collapse, where a figure of ninety-two thousand crore rupees was cited. He warns the fallout here could be several times worse.

scenes.title: Social security on the line
scenes.say: The complaint alleges negligence, administrative failures and preferential treatment of private firms, and says failing to protect these funds could hurt the social security of millions.

scenes.title: The union's deadline

items.what: FM, CAG, Cabinet Secretary, Rahul Gandhi

scenes.say: Copies have gone to the Finance Minister, the CAG, the Cabinet Secretary and Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi. If nothing changes, the union says it will blockade the PFRDA office on 20 December.
scenes.speak: Copies have gone to the Finance Minister, the C A G, the Cabinet Secretary and Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi. If nothing changes, the union says it will blockade the P F R D A office on the twentieth of December.

scenes.title: Claims, not findings
scenes.say: An important caveat. These are allegations. They have not been independently verified, and the NPS Trust, PFRDA and the two firms have not publicly responded.
scenes.speak: An important caveat. These are allegations. They have not been independently verified, and the N P S Trust, P F R D A and the two firms have not publicly responded.

scenes.title: Risk in a compulsory pension
scenes.say: But the row raises a bigger question. NPS members cannot simply walk away, so the bar for showing where their money goes has to be higher.

scenes.title: Disclosure settles it
scenes.say: If the deal is sound, publishing the due diligence and safeguards would settle it. If not, the pressure for an audit will only grow, along with the worry of nearly 1 crore employees.
scenes.speak: If the deal is sound, publishing the due diligence and safeguards would settle it. If not, the pressure for an audit will only grow, along with the worry of nearly one crore employees.
